reason: I've lost my smell and taste for two days.
diagnosis: Likely COVID-19 causing acute anosmia and ageusia, suggested by sudden loss of smell/taste with mild fatigue and possible low-grade fever despite no other localising symptoms.
keyPoints: Onset and duration of smell/taste loss
Any COVID symptoms: fever, cough, dyspnea, sore throat, congestion, myalgias
Exposure history and household contacts, especially sick contacts
Past nasal/sinus disease or head trauma as alternative causes of anosmia
Pregnancy/medications not directly relevant but check for other causes of symptoms
Red flags: chest pain, shortness of breath, persistent fever or worsening symptoms
